note: Module lists were read off each institution's own course pages where marked verified. Where verified is false, the programme exists and the subject coverage is an informed estimate rather than a checked module mapping, usually because the module list is not published in English. Universities revise modules every year: confirm against the institution's own pages before relying on an overlap.

programmes.prog: Artificial Intelligence and Data Engineering MSc
programmes.note: Built by merging modules from UCL's Software Systems Engineering MSc and its machine learning master's, plus new data engineering modules. Unusually strong on the engineering side, which is exactly the gap in most AI curricula.

programmes.prog: Artificial Intelligence for Sustainable Development MSc
programmes.note: One of the few master's programmes with a named Generative AI module and a dedicated responsible AI module, so the ethics and genAI rows here are genuinely redundant for you.

programmes.prog: Data Science and Machine Learning MSc
core: Modules spanning artificial intelligence, deep learning, digital finance and probabilistic modelling
programmes.note: Module list published by UCL is indicative rather than fixed, so treat the overlap as approximate. Graduate destinations listed by UCL include Amazon, Bloomberg, IBM and Morgan Stanley.

options: Pattern Recognition, Neural Networks & Deep Learning (15)
Philosophy and Ethics of Artificial Intelligence (15)
programmes.note: Almost entirely optional modules around a single 60-credit project, so the overlap depends heavily on what you pick. Notably strong on agents and multi-agent systems, which is the one area most degrees ignore.

core: Science Application & Engagement at the Forefront of AI (30)
options: Advanced Topics in AI: AI and Robotics Engineering (15)
programmes.note: Aimed at science and maths graduates rather than computer scientists. Carries a group project built on real case studies from industry, academia and government, and has an entrepreneurship option that most AI master's do not.

programmes.prog: MSc in Advanced Computer Science (Artificial Intelligence)
core: Minimum of 6 modules across two terms, plus a dissertation
options: Algorithmic Foundations of Collective Decision Making
programmes.note: Theory first, with a strong mathematical foundation, and an AI specialisation you graduate with named on the degree. Deliberately not a practitioner course: nothing here teaches you to ship an LLM product, so the whole LLM and agents side of this list stays relevant.

programmes.prog: MPhil in Machine Learning and Machine Intelligence
core: Taught modules plus a research thesis
programmes.note: Small cohort, heavily theoretical, with an emphasis on Bayesian methods and uncertainty quantification. Module names here are from secondary sources, so check the Computer Laboratory's own pages before relying on the overlap.

options: Fourth theme chosen from data engineering, software engineering or cyber security
programmes.note: Organised as four themes of two course units each, three of them mandatory. Unusual in still teaching symbolic AI properly alongside machine learning. Manchester lists partnerships with IBM, AWS and NVIDIA, so the vendor credentials on this page connect directly.
The machine learning sibling of Manchester's AI MSc, adding decision making under uncertainty. Covers deep RL, which most UK master's leave out.

options: Graph Data Analytics and Representation Learning
programmes.note: Statistics-led rather than engineering-led, and it wants a solid quantitative background going in. The only programme in this list with a named time series module, which is why that topic is marked covered. Note: you asked about LSEG, which is the London Stock Exchange Group and not a university; this is LSE.

programmes.prog: MSc Artificial Intelligence and Data Science
programmes.note: Covers classical ML, machine vision, big data and the ethics strand. Leaves the whole LLM application layer untouched: no RAG, no agents, no evaluation, no MLOps. That gap is precisely what Phase 2 of this list exists to fill.

programmes.inst: Mohamed bin Zayed University of AI
options: Trustworthy AI and attacks against ML systems
programmes.note: The world's first university dedicated entirely to AI, created under the UAE's AI 2031 strategy. Structure is 8 core, 16 elective, 2 internship, 2 research methods and 8 thesis credits. Research-weighted with a built-in internship, and it teaches adversarial attacks on ML systems, which is rare at master's level.

programmes.inst: Mohamed bin Zayed University of AI
options: Kernel methods and statistical learning theory
programmes.note: The closest thing in this list to a degree that genuinely covers the LLM layer, since NLP here goes to research depth. If you are on this programme, the beginner LLM rows on this page are redundant; the engineering and MLOps rows are not.

programmes.inst: Mohamed bin Zayed University of AI
programmes.note: Assumes solid Python including NumPy, pandas, matplotlib and basic Git on entry, so it skips the beginner tooling entirely. Includes a seven-week maths foundations course, which is the single most commonly missing piece elsewhere.

programmes.inst: Mohamed bin Zayed University of AI
programmes.note: MBZUAI's computer vision department is ranked inside the global top 15 by its own account, with research in robotic vision, generative media and trustworthy AI.

programmes.prog: Master's in Artificial Intelligence / Computer Science and Technology
core: Published module lists are not available in English at the level this list needs
programmes.note: Department of Computer Science and Technology offers master's and doctoral programmes covering AI, machine learning, systems architecture and human-computer interaction, with English-taught graduate programmes available. Tsinghua also has a dedicated College of AI. Overlap here is an informed estimate, not a verified module mapping: confirm against the department's own pages before relying on it.

core: Module lists not verified in English
programmes.note: Specialised AI programmes with an emphasis on theoretical foundations alongside applications, and research strength in computer vision and deep learning. English-taught master's routes require TOEFL or IELTS plus GRE for non-native speakers. Overlap is an estimate.

Formerly Tokyo Institute of Technology. A dedicated AI graduate major rather than an AI track inside computer science, with explicit English presentation and internship components built into the curriculum.

programmes.prog: Master's programmes in AI and information science
programmes.note: Japan's leading institution for AI and robotics research. Programme structure not verified at module level here, so the overlap is an estimate.

programmes.prog: MS in Artificial Intelligence / MS in Data Science and Statistics
programmes.note: KAIST runs a dedicated AI graduate school and a separate data science and statistics route. English-taught options available. Overlap is an estimate until the module lists are checked.

programmes.prog: MS in Artificial Intelligence / MS in Data Science
programmes.note: Separate AI and data science master's routes through SNU's graduate school of data science. Overlap is an estimate.

options: 9 credits of electives from an approved list
programmes.note: Fully online through Penn State World Campus as well as in residence, which makes it one of the few US AI master's genuinely reachable from anywhere. Interdisciplinary and deployment-oriented rather than research-first.
